post-p4.description: Automated output of P4 RefinementAgent — input to P5 ValidatorAgent

final.description: Final deliverable after P5⇌P6 automated loop followed by human-in-the-loop review in SysIDE / Eclipse IDE (§III.C of the paper). These are the files evaluated in Table I.

note_on_pipeline_report: The automated pipeline (P5 validation) produces a report reflecting output before human review; this report is not committed and can be regenerated by re-running the system. The paper's Table I metrics (SLOC=3,043, error-free=99.8%, errors=5) were obtained after human-in-the-loop review in SysIDE/Eclipse IDE on the final/ .sysml files.
note_on_cost_and_time: Full-run totals from Table I of the paper: cost=USD 3.69, time=75.0 min (P1–P6 inclusive).
